objective: Cheap geometry-only screen of a zero-noop learned low-rank projected-value to RWKV-read compatibility map using four-rank in-batch InfoNCE.

authorization_basis.method_change: Learn a bounded residual compatibility map and contrast each state against three in-batch donor states; do not interpret this as causal teacher-forced preference.

architecture.input: detached projected slot value in RWKV state-read space
architecture.initialization: Down normal(0,1/sqrt(32)); Up zero; exact forward no-op

training.rows: first four source rows from inherited already-open fit schedule step 1

stopping_rule.pass: May justify implementation of a separately preregistered causal one-update preflight; does not authorize it automatically.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, strength holdout, or run generation.
